# JUDO JSL VS Code Extension

> A VS Code extension for the JUDO Specification Language (JSL) that bundles an embedded Java-based language server providing code completion, diagnostics, and symbol lookup via LSP.

Key facts:
- TypeScript 4.6 extension host + Java 21 language server (LSP over stdio)
- Build: Maven 3.9.4+ with frontend-maven-plugin for Node.js/npm/vsce toolchain
- Single-module project — no Maven submodules
- Key dependency: vscode-languageclient 8.0.1
- Language server: `hu.blackbelt.judo.meta.jsl.server.embedded` (bundled JARs, not compiled here)
- TextMate grammar sourced from `judo-jsl-tmbundle` dependency
- Packaged as `.vsix` for manual installation (not on VS Code Marketplace)
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0

## Source

- [src/extension.ts](src/extension.ts): Extension entry point — creates LanguageClient, spawns Java language server, configures LSP
- [src/jsl/bin/jsl-standalone](src/jsl/bin/jsl-standalone): POSIX launcher script for the embedded Java language server
- [src/jsl/bin/jsl-standalone.bat](src/jsl/bin/jsl-standalone.bat): Windows launcher script for the language server

## Configuration

- [package.json](package.json): VS Code extension manifest — activation events, language contributions, npm scripts
- [pom.xml](pom.xml): Maven build configuration — dependency management, frontend-maven-plugin, profiles, version properties
- [src/tsconfig.json](src/tsconfig.json): TypeScript compiler config (ES6, CommonJS, output to ../out)
- [language-configuration.json](language-configuration.json): JSL language rules — bracket pairs, comment syntax, auto-closing pairs

## Depends on

- [judo-meta-jsl](../../models/judo-meta-jsl): models/judo-meta-jsl

## Optional

- [.github/workflows/build.yml](.github/workflows/build.yml): Main CI pipeline — build, test, deploy, tag, release
- [.vscode/launch.json](.vscode/launch.json): Debug configuration for launching extension in a new VS Code window
